context_for_next_testing_agent: Background PDF generation feature fully tested. Key findings: 1) POST /api/ir-thermography-report/{report_id}/pdf/generate creates job and returns job_id immediately, 2) GET /api/ir-thermography-report/{report_id}/pdf/status/{job_id} returns status (queued -> processing -> completed), 3) GET /api/ir-thermography-report/{report_id}/pdf/download/{job_id} returns actual PDF file, 4) Jobs are persisted to MongoDB pdf_jobs collection, 5) Frontend uses direct download for small reports (<20 items) and background generation for large reports (>=20 items), 6) Frontend shows loading state and polls for status during background generation.

implementation_details.backend_approach: Hybrid approach - in-memory dictionary for real-time status updates during processing, MongoDB for persistent storage of completed PDFs
